bio.text: Gabe Okoye, a Democrat from Lawrenceville, was elected to the Georgia House of Representatives in 2022 and was sworn in on January 9, 2023; he represents District 102, which includes portions of Gwinnett County.
In a House press release, Okoye said he may bring his professional experience as a licensed civil and environmental engineer to his committee work.

sources.title: Rep. Gabe Okoye Sworn in, Receives Committee Assignments for the 2023-2024 Legislative Term
